question: Who among the following is the Director of the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission appointed in January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Praveen Sharma**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Praveen Sharma **was appointed as the **Director of the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) in January 2023**.
 
• He was **selected for the role under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare in Delhi. **
 
• The ABDM** aims t**o develop the digital health infrastructure of the country.
 
• The National Health Authority (NHA) is the **apex body responsible for implementing the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana, India's flagship public health insurance scheme. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **R.S. Sharma**
 
• **Full Name: Ram Sharan Sharma**
 
 
• A **prominent historian** specializing in ancient and early medieval Indian history.
 
• **Authored influential books such as "India's Ancient Past" and "Aspects of Political Ideas and Institutions in Ancient India"**.
 
• Known for his Marxist perspective on Indian history, emphasizing socio-economic aspects.
 
• Played a **key role in historical debates, especially concerning the Aryan migration** theory and the origins of the caste system.
